notes.title: V0.8.0 – Major Update – New Floor Available!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey Cybers,[/b][/p][p]We’re back with an update that brings a brand-new floor featuring two new bosses, a new cutscene, a skin vendor, a new currency added to the game’s economy, Steam Deck verification, and much more.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Floor (5th Floor)[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/dbe9221594f9bf7510e4dcd01cea35efd79069d9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can now reach the [b]5th floor[/b], getting even closer to the top of Tree Tech![/p][p][/p][h2]Meet the new boss: Kram[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/3895db358a37574e0c7588ad64706613a044454e.gif"][/img][/p][p]Kram is impulsive and chaotic. He’s always seeking solutions through self-medication and experimentation with new forms of hybrids. He would switch sides if it ever benefited him. Kram plays a crucial role in managing the laboratory floor.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/75c64e9adc3b2b19fad82923ddf8139c04506986.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Meet the new boss: [b]C2000[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/aa69373fb2a7aea12041efdc0aaa32da99d1bbac.gif"][/img][/p][p]A living cocoon whose sole purpose is to give life to the [b]Rambonator[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/fc334c6be795bb63febba1d228c3a26a26008292.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Skin Vendor[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/912be1ed38111ff5904232621441225912bff8fa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Unlock up to [b]6 new skins[/b], each one coming with its own [b]active ability, passive ability, and special talent[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/b6af054de10747f9598c7da65a857b81110a1ac1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Discover more about Edward’s dark past[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/18573bbe135be1aec163940e38c932ab944b50fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Deck Verified[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/49b92c8784aa5866ba601634b4c6ccb97f70fe49.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Cyberwar: Neon City[/b] is now officially [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b], bringing full compatibility with the Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][h2]On-Screen Metrics[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/c672cb0906cef7c1ba82028c2a88194dd1f12583.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can now enable Blue’s attribute metrics to be displayed directly on-screen.[/p][p][/p][h2]New DJ Interface[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/aa66b07f9bb0064545265b2ecfb30485d80e0c56.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h2]General Additions[/h2][list][*][p]The blind tattoo artist now has his own theme music.[/p][/*][*][p]New tracks added to the rooms and bosses of the 5th floor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Neon Coin[/b] introduced into the game’s economy — earn this special coin after defeating bosses and use it to unlock new skins from the Printer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gray Health[/b] implemented.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]General Adjustments[/h2][list][*][p]Overall combat balancing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple miscellaneous bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Applied several visual improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v0.7.43 update patch
notes.content:
[h3]Implementations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Playtime added to save game and visible in the Main Menu
[*] "New Record" added to the game over screen for longer runs
[*] Main NPCs now have an exclamation mark above their heads whenever they have something new to say

[b]Teleport Duck[/b]
[*] Improved design

[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] When using the duck to teleport directly to floor 4, Printer would disappear

[*] Pause menu not saving sound preferences
[*] Pause menu displaying unnecessary resolutions

[*] Enemy shots would still sound even with the game paused
[*] Redtopus challenges not resetting junk drops, causing balancing issues

[*] Deadly Trigger skill in the skill tree increasing damage only for current Blue

[b]Tutorial[/b]
[*] Dialogues corrected
[*] NT8000 portrait was flipped
[*] Car in Neon City trapping the player
[*] During the walk-shoot-move-by-mouse sequence, shots were not following the cursor
[*] UI sometimes freezing the game when buying Voice Hack in the skill tree using a controller
[*] Pausing during the tutorial causes the player to lose controller inputs
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy spawn visuals adjusted
[*] Slot machine interface, sounds, icons, and feedbacks adjusted
[*] Some UI texts in English and Portuguese were corrected
[*] Dash system remade
[*] Dialogue text size adjusted for Steam Deck
[*] Tutorial teaching how to shoot in Neon City improved

[b]Menus[/b]
[*] Some menus simplified
[*] General usability adjustments for controllers
[/list]

notes.title: v0.7.3 - Major Update - New floor available
notes.content:
Hey, Cybers!

We're back with an update that adds a new floor with a brand-new boss, a new cutscene, soundtrack, more items, balance updates, and bug fixes.

[h2]New Floor (4th Floor)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/6accead23c57640dc2bc6cacfe3b4d5f88edf667.png[/img]
You can now climb up to the 4th floor and get even closer to the top of Tree Tech!

[h3]Meet the new boss: Mecha Nika TV![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/d27c6605191781dbe9f0d5764e5e82cb42aea962.gif[/img]
A new boss has been added, and its name is [b]Mecha Nika TV[/b]. The entire floor is built around it! A giant robot controlled by a streamer obsessed with pleasing her audience—her name is Nikana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/ec1055452febfb8e6f39ef06f8e8754c71fb1578.gif[/img]

[h3]Uncover more of Neon City's dark past[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/18facd0acafb22f6d8a09f342e84a90197b9cadb.png[/img]
Discover a major revelation about Neon City's story after defeating the 4th-floor boss!

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New music tracks added
[*] New balance adjustments applied
[*] Various visual improvements
[*] General combat tweaks
[*] Fixed several visual glitches
[*] Fixed multiple collision issues
[*] Fixed grammar mistakes
[*] Fixed various bugs
[*] Fixed talent bugs for different Blue
[/list]

notes.title: Cyberwar Neon City Is Out Now! 🦈
notes.content:
Hi Cybers,

It’s the big day we’ve all been waiting for! The start of Early Access is here!

After four years, our little indie game Cyberwar is launching in EA today.

The biggest THANK YOU to everyone who has supported us, provided feedback, reported bugs, and been patient with us!

[b]It would also help guide our development and progress during Early Access if you took a moment to share your thoughts on Steam or provide any feedback you may have.[/b]

Watch our new trailer here:
[previewyoutube=wbWhLQRJ9LQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Check out Cyberwar's roadmap to 1.0:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/6a44121ea297a14cb9e8e169857b24f797e341ba.jpg[/img]

Here’s what we’ve got planned for the future of Cyberwar. Things may change slightly as we listen closely to your feedback, but this is what we’re working on for the foreseeable future.

We’re so happy to have Cyberwar in Early Access, and we can’t wait to see what’s next.

Hope you enjoy Cyberwar.

Love,
Cyber Monkey Team.

notes.title: Cyberwar will be out in Early Access on September 24th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937020/245083cdc3c06c6c6812f677cf7b31e4bc932153.png[/img]

Hey, Cybers! We are delighted to announce that Cyberwar: Neon City will enter Early Access on September 24th!

So, why Early Access, you ask? Early Access will allow us to hear your feedback as we continue to shape and refine the game in the leadup to the 1.0 release. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts along the way!

Check out Cyberwar: Neon City official trailer:
[previewyoutube=d9sHuK2pz30;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Roadmap[/h3]
[b] Early Access Launch:[/b]
[list]
[*] First 3st floors 
[*] 5 bosses
[*] +30 enemies
[*] Initial language support: Portugueses and English
[*] 4 initial shark-guns
[*] Various upgrade possibilities
[/list]
[b]November:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4st floor added
[*] New boss
[*] New environment, new enemies, new itens, etc
[*] More language support: Spanish, italian, french, german and japonese
[/list]
[b]December:[/b]
[list]
[*] 5st floor added
[*] New boss
[*] New environment
[*] New shark-gun added
[*] More general content
[*] More language support: simplified chinese, Korean and russian
[/list]
[b]Q1 2025[/b]
[list]
[*] Launch 1.0 – Last Early Access Update!
[*] Last shark-gun added
[*] End Game: Defeat the final boss
[*] And way more...
[/list]
[h2]Want to follow closely the development of the game?[/h2]
Join our oficial [url=https://discord.gg/RKG8Rfj9Kb]Discord Server[/url] for the latest updates about Cyberwar and participate with Other members of the Community!

notes.title: Cyberwar Demo - Update 0.9.2
notes.content:
Hi Cybers,

I just updated the demo with new content, balance changes and fixes! Thanks everyone for your feedback over these past days!

[b]New Content[/b]

[list]
[*] New projectile selector when reprinted.
[*] New scene showing the player's location within TreeTech.
[*] Boss portrait before starting a battle.
[*] Improved localization for the Portuguese language.
[*] Coin and junk rooms added to the route map.
[*] Mini Boss Room.
[*] New general sounds.
[*] Enemy position indicator if they are off-screen.
[*] Elemental upgrades to shots:
[*] Fire – 20% chance to burn enemies for 2 seconds.
[*] Electricity – 15% chance to stun enemies for 1 second.
[*] Freezing – 18% chance to freeze enemies for 2 seconds.
[*] Poison upgrade to shots: 22% chance to poison enemies for 3 seconds.
[*] Upgrades can now level up when accumulated: lvl1, lvl2, lvl3...
[*] Upgrades that increase Blue's damage.
[*] Special dash upgrades:
[*] Hole Dash: Summons a sphere that deals area damage to enemies.
[*] Thunder Dash: Summons lightning where it begins.
[*] Blade Dash: Creates a blade where it begins.
[*] Bubble Dash: Creates a water sphere that deals area damage to enemies.
[*] Hit upgrades:
[*] Tentacle Hit: Creates a tentacle that attacks enemies where it takes damage.
[*] Whale Hit: Creates a whale that deals area damage where it takes damage.
[*] New items in the merchant:
[*] Vampirism – Slightly increases Printer's life with each defeated enemy.
[*] Drones – Robots that follow you and attack enemies.
[*] Gas Mask – Gases no longer slow you down.
[*] Bargain – Reduces item prices at the merchant by 50%.
[*] Added drones:
[*] Birdrone – A bird drone that throws an explosive egg.
[*] Jellydrone – A jellyfish that stuns enemies on contact.
[*] Stormdrone – A drone with melee attacks on the nearest enemy.
[*] Barrels now catch fire when exploding and deal damage to the player and enemies.
[*] It is now possible to destroy some objects in the tutorial.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Balanced enemy spawning.
[*] Movement fixes for various enemies.
[*] Automatic switch between gamepad and keyboard/mouse.
[*] General input fixes.
[*] Speed and dash distance buffs have been removed.
[*] Printer appearing on the loading screen.
[*] Wall dash not functioning correctly.
[*] Improved damage feedback.
[*] New merchant room.
[*] Balanced item prices at the merchant.
[*] HP was not increasing correctly when using a life item.
[*] Enemy shots exploded before contact.
[*] Traps change color and self-destruct at the end of runs.
[*] Pistol and ricochet shot ranges adjusted.
[*] Upgrades selector in upgrade rooms optimized.
[*] Opening chests now automatically collects the reward.
[*] Camera positioning fixes in some scenes.
[*] Removed heart tiles from the ground to avoid confusion with health.
[*] Adjusted health room to not increase maximum HP.
[*] General UI fixes.
[*] The merchant will now always appear on the route map.
[*] A mini-boss room will now always appear on the route map.
[*] It is no longer possible to fall into holes.
[*] Dog in the tutorial without interaction.
[*] HP and enemy damage balancing.
[/list]
